indicators.title: Recently created email
indicators.reason: Limited email history adds a weak identity signal.
indicators.context: New users also create new email accounts. This signal is never sufficient on its own.

indicators.title: Device used by multiple identities
indicators.reason: The same synthetic fingerprint is present on several accounts.
indicators.context: Households and shared workstations can explain device reuse; related activity must corroborate it.

indicators.title: Repeated region inconsistency
indicators.reason: Observed regions repeatedly differ from the declared region.
indicators.context: Travel and network routing can explain location changes.

indicators.title: Repeated unsuccessful sign-ins
indicators.reason: Repeated failed attempts accompany the observed activity.
indicators.context: Credential mistakes can produce the same pattern.

indicators.title: Unusual form-completion behaviour
indicators.reason: Completion or editing activity differs from the independent reference cohort.
indicators.context: Fast completion alone may reflect familiarity or assistive tools.

indicators.title: Recovery contact reused
indicators.reason: Several identities share the same recovery contact.
indicators.context: A family contact may be shared legitimately. Inspect other links and timing.

indicators.context: Shared housing or offices can explain address reuse.
